verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a business banking and payments SaaS product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any in-product AI assistant or task delegation. The published llms.txt file is documentation aimed at external LLMs, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
